analysis: The only change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md is a 'Last updated' date bump (line 3) and one added environment-variable table row (patch hunk near head line 1741) for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED, which keeps the stock Qwen GDN prompt kernel when set to 0. The two supplied units (head lines 1-404 and 405-830) do not include the added row at line 1741, so I relied on the patch excerpt for it. I reviewed the supplied text and found no security-relevant behavior changes in it. This is documentation only, so no code, authorization, attestation, encryption, key custody, or cache storage controls change. The documented variable is a numerical/kernel selection toggle for prompt prefill. It is not a security control and is not tied to the prefix-cache gate (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE, T-041), the TTL, the HMAC lookup tags, or coordinator-authored cacheSalt scoping. The Qwen GDN kernel change itself lives in libs/mlx-swift-lm GatedDelta.swift, which is not supplied. I could not verify its implementation, such as GPU residual data handling (T-028) or output correctness, so those remain unexamined by this pass. Other supplied text describes existing behavior only: logout revocation, with HTTP 204 as the only confirmation of revocation; the cache settings commands; and the scheduling and switch flows. I saw no contradiction of the retained threat-model statements (A-008, T-053, T-041).
